notes: Wrecking a car with realistic physics, explosions and shattering debris is Simulation's Physics Sim subgenre — ramps, ragdoll props and breakable assemblies are the entertainment — and with no lap or finish condition it is not Racing. Kept the preset's world-open shape, read as one small contiguous map because the author asked for a single ten-storey building rather than a city block; the tower is the spawn point and the drop off it is the destruction, so hazard-kill is bent to the impact zone at its base and path-circulation to the drivable approach ramps. With no user to ask, I assumed the run ends at the crash itself since the author said wrecking the car is the whole point, so no scoring or winner zone was added. Nothing says the car drives inside the building, so this stays a P0 exterior build with no interior transition.
